svg.text: CDSS + BCMA: machines that guard meds

g.text: ALERTS
allergy, dose,
duplicate, clash!
REMINDERS
vaccines, screens,
rechecks due!
ORDER SETS
bundles built-in:
sepsis, DKA!
FATIGUE FIGHT
read + decide +
reason every one!
BCMA SCAN
wristband + packet
+ 5 rights!
CDSS = alerts + reminders + order sets + calculators + guidelines at the point of
care. Catches: allergies, overdoses, duplicates, interactions, missed vaccines, overdue
rechecks. Fails when: ignored, overridden blindly, or trusted instead of assessed.
FATIGUE (exam core!): 100 daily alerts → 95 noise → brain mutes ALL → the real one kills.
Fight: read EVERY alert, decide consciously, document override REASONS, report noisy rules
(super-user → analyst → retune!). Never "click-through nursing" — overrides need reasons.
BCMA (bar-code meds admin): scan wristband + scan packet + system matches order → 5 rights
verified electronically. Workarounds KILL: pre-scanned bands, scanned-then-carried trays,
"scanner broken, skip it" — each bypass deletes the safety net. Scanner truly dead? Full
manual 5-rights + 2 identifiers + report + document.
SMART PUMPS + CALCULATORS: drug libraries limit doses; paediatric calculators need weight
VERIFIED (wrong weight = wrong everything — NUT M2 measure!). Independent double-checks
for high-risk drugs: insulin, heparin, chemo, K+ infusions (GER M4!).
AUTOMATION BIAS: "the computer said so" is not nursing judgment (M01 wisdom!). System says
discharge + gut says deteriorating → reassess, escalate, document. Computers suggest;
nurses decide; audit trails remember who clicked.
LINKS: M02 CPOE/verify · GER M4 polypharmacy · NUT M4/M5 dosing · PRO-I compass.
MANTRA: "read it, scan it, verify it — then give it."
